name: single lean back quadriceps stretch
description: Kneeling with one leg folded and leaning back to stretch the quadriceps.
instructions: Kneel on both knees, then lift one foot out in front so that the other leg is folded.
Place your hands behind you on the floor.
Lean back slowly until you feel a stretch in the front of the folded thigh.
Keep your hips lifted and avoid sagging into the lower back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
